Cost: 2 Investiture

One crack fractures. All cracks shatter.

Spend 2 Investiture and test Blue vs. Cognitive. On success, remove all your Omens within Attunement Range simultaneously; each enemy whose Omen is removed takes [Tier][Die] spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of your next turn.

CascadeSweep0000.description: Chaos. THE OWNER-SWEEP (H1 targetList, 2bU): ONE shared Blue roll — yours, on the card — then every Omen-bearer within Blue Attunement Range is gated on its OWN Cognitive (Ben 06-18); the rules below run per member.

CascadeRel000000.description: Chaos. The member's Omen is removed first, so the card reads remove-then-damage as the prose does. Every swept member is on the ledger, so this never short-circuits.

CascadeDmg000000.description: Chaos. [Tier][Die] spirit per removed Omen, its own roll per bearer.

CascadeDis000000.description: Chaos. And Disoriented until the start of YOUR next turn.

EntropyStrikeH10.description: Chaos. Blue vs the target's Cognitive defense, engine-resolved on YOUR roll. 07-24p: replaced a preUseItem TAKEOVER (iron rule 2b) — the roll is now the player's, per Ben's ruling that deity conversions match the heroic ones.

EntropyStrikeOme.description: Chaos. On a success the target bears your Omen. `evict: refuse` is Chaos's own cap behaviour and the card says so — Order and Fate fizzle their oldest instead, which is why H3 has the field.

EntropyStrikeDmg.description: Chaos. And [Tier][Die] spirit. Ordered AFTER the Omen so the card reads place-then-damage, as the prose does.

UnravelFill00000.description: Chaos. THE FILL (H3 enemies-range, 2bU): an Omen on every living enemy within Blue Attunement Range, nearest first, until the cap (@tier) refuses — 'up to your cap'.

UnravelSweep0000.description: Chaos. THE DETONATION (H1 targetList vs: none, 2bU): no test — every bearer resolves immediately, SCENE-WIDE (the card's range clause binds the placement, not the removal). The rules below run per bearer.

UnravelRel000000.description: Chaos. Each bearer's Omen is removed as it detonates.

UnravelIso000000.description: Chaos. The Isolated branch: a bearer that is Isolated when its Omen is removed takes 2[Tier][Die] VITAL instead — and skips the spirit + Disorient below.

UnravelDmg000000.description: Chaos. The ordinary branch: [Tier][Die] + Awareness spirit — skipped for Isolated bearers (unlessTargetStatus, a silent skip so the rule after it still runs).

UnravelDis000000.description: Chaos. And the ordinary branch Disorients until the start of YOUR next turn (Isolated bearers take the vital instead — no Disorient, matching the card).

UnweavePick00000.description: Chaos. The DISPEL (H6 source: effects, 2bU): one button per enabled Active Effect on the target; the GM clicks the one that counts as magical (adjudication stays at the table, removal is one click). Deletion is the pick's intrinsic payload — success rules are NOT dispatched for a picked effect.

The sense-reveal spec (edha-sense-reveal, 2bU): omen-bearers render to YOUR client through walls/fog (the per-viewer RENDERING is ENGINE_OWNED — see the tree-section header), and once per round a creature bearing YOUR Omen taking damage within Blue Attunement Range recovers you 1 Investiture (the range gate is the card's own clause — the old engine code never enforced it).
